resident_copy_search.method: Bounded metadata enumeration by exact basename and declared size, followed by nofollow hash verification; nonmatching candidates were rejected. Search is not exhaustive for truncated roots.

limitations: All expected identities are now bound, but 137 exact fixture members are not resident in the inspected candidates.
Hash equality is byte provenance only. It does not establish forcing units, intervals, model compatibility, parameter science or rights.
Later production/correction inputs with different hashes were not substituted; original December 2021 origin and two issues remain unchanged.
Original dataless files were not opened or hydrated. No native execution or inherited source import occurred.
Raw inherited files and full private custody receipts stay under ignored local staging.
